types.title: Content types
types.description: The kinds of content this site has, and the fields each one's items carry.
types.label: Content types
types.noSchemaHint: No field schema: items keep whatever fields plugins or imports give them.

empty.title: No content types yet
empty.body: Add a type for each kind of content, such as books or events, and give it the fields its items need.

create.title: New content type
create.description: The name is part of every item's address and cannot change later.
create.label: Label
create.labelHint: Plural, as the sidebar shows it, e.g. Books
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter, at most {{max}} characters. Items live at /{{name}}/…
create.nameHintEmpty: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter, at most {{max}} characters.
create.hierarchicalHint: Like pages: nested items with addresses under their parent. Cannot change later.
create.archiveHint: A page at /name/ that lists the published items.

errors.label: 1 to {{max}} characters
errors.name: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter, at most {{max}} characters

form.settingsDescription: How the type appears in the admin and on the site.
form.label: Label
form.name: Name
form.nameFixed: The name is part of every item's address and cannot change.
form.hierarchicalFixed: Set when the type was created; it cannot change.
form.archiveHint: A page at /{{name}}/ that lists the published items.
form.builtIn: Built-in type: it cannot be deleted, but its label, archive and fields can change.
form.invalid: Fix the marked fields to save
form.reloaded: Reloaded: you now see their version

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to this type are not saved yet.

form.notFound: This content type does not exist (any more).

builder.title: Fields
builder.description: What each item of this type holds besides its title and body. Drag or use the menu to reorder.
builder.noSchema: This type has no field schema yet: its items take any fields. Adding a field gives it one; fields its items hold that the schema lacks are then removed on each item's next save.
builder.emptyNested: No sub-fields yet: a repeater needs at least one.

kindHints.rich_text: Formatted text with headings, lists and links
kindHints.number: A number, with a point for decimals
kindHints.select: One of a list of options
kindHints.relation: Another item, of any type or of the types checked below
kindHints.media: A file from the media library

editor.label: Label
editor.labelHint: What the editor shows above the input
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: The key in each item's fields and in templates
editor.kindWarning: This field was saved as {{kind}}: existing values may no longer be valid, and such items need a new value before they can be saved again.
editor.renameNote: Renamed from {{name}}: values stored under the old name are not carried over.
editor.requiredHint: Items cannot be saved without a value
editor.optionsHint: 1 to {{max}} distinct options, in the order the editor lists them
editor.targetsHint: Leave every box empty for items of any type. The editor's picker searches only the checked types.

change.title: Save changes to the fields?
change.body: Items of this type were written against the old fields. Nothing in them changes now: each item is checked against the new fields when it is next saved.
change.removedHint: Their existing values stay stored until each item is saved, and are then removed.
change.renamedHint: Old values are not carried over: they stay stored until each item is saved, and are then removed.
change.newlyRequiredHint: Items without a value cannot be saved until they get one.
change.kindChangedHint: Existing values may no longer be valid: such an item cannot be saved until its value is changed.
change.optionsRemovedHint: Items holding a removed option cannot be saved until another is chosen.
change.targetsNarrowedHint: Items pointing at an item of a type no longer listed cannot be saved until the relation is changed.

delete.title: Delete this type
delete.body: Only a type without items (none in any status, the trash included) and without taxonomies can be deleted.
delete.confirmBody: The type {{name}} and its field schema are removed for good. This cannot be undone.

reasons.hasContent: It still has items (in some status, the trash included). Delete them first.
reasons.relationTarget: A relation field of the type {{type}} points at it: remove it there first.

errors.name: Lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most {{max}} characters
errors.duplicate: Another field on this level already has this name
errors.reserved: featured_image is the core featured image field; choose another name
errors.label: At most {{max}} characters
errors.tooMany: At most {{max}} fields on one level
errors.options: A choice field needs 1 to {{max}} options
errors.noSubFields: A repeater needs at least one sub-field
errors.typeMedia: A relation cannot point at media: use a media field
errors.typeUnknown: {{type}} is not a content type (any more): remove it

taxonomies.title: Taxonomies
taxonomies.description: The ways content is grouped, such as categories and tags, and the types each one applies to.
taxonomies.descriptionTerms: The ways content is grouped, such as categories and tags. Open one to manage its terms.
taxonomies.label: Taxonomies
taxonomies.countFailed: The terms could not be loaded
taxonomies.appliesToNone: Applies to no content type yet

empty.title: No taxonomies yet
empty.body: Add a taxonomy to group content in a new way, such as genres for books or venues for events.

create.title: New taxonomy
create.description: The name is part of every term's address and cannot change later.

form.label: Label
form.labelHint: Plural, as the admin shows it, e.g. Genres
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter, at most {{max}} characters. Term archives live at /{{name}}/…
form.nameFixed: The name is part of every term's address and cannot change.
form.hierarchicalHint: Like categories: terms nest under other terms. Without it, terms are flat like tags. Cannot change later.
form.structureFixed: Set when the taxonomy was created; it cannot change.
form.typesHint: The editor offers this taxonomy for items of the checked types (at most {{max}}).

settings.title: {{label}} settings
settings.description: Its label and the content types it applies to.

delete.hasTerms: It still has terms: delete them first.
delete.termsLeft_one: It still has {{count}} term. A taxonomy can only be deleted once it has none: delete the term first.
delete.termsLeft_other: It still has {{count}} terms. A taxonomy can only be deleted once it has none: delete its terms first.
delete.confirmBody: The taxonomy goes for good and the editor stops offering it. This cannot be undone.

terms.treeHint: Drag a term next to another term's children to move it there, or use Move to… in its menu. Terms under the same parent are listed alphabetically.
terms.newDescription: Terms group items; each term has its own archive page.
terms.editDescription: Changes apply to every item filed under this term.
terms.name: Name
terms.slugHintNew: Leave empty to derive it from the name. A slug in use gets -2, -3, … added.
terms.slugHintEdit: The archive is at /{{taxonomy}}/slug/. A new slug moves it, and a public archive's old address redirects to the new one. Empty keeps the current slug.
terms.descriptionHint: Themes may show it on the term's archive page.
terms.gone: This term was deleted by someone else.

noMatch.title: No terms match “{{q}}”
noMatch.body: The filter looks at names, slugs and descriptions.

empty.title: No terms yet
empty.bodyNested: Add the first term of {{label}}; terms can nest under one another.
empty.bodyFlat: Add the first term of {{label}}, or create terms while writing in the editor.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.description: Choose its new parent. Terms under the same parent are listed alphabetically.
move.cycle: {{parent}} is now under {{name}}, so {{name}} cannot go under it. The tree shows the current state.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Items filed under it lose this term. This cannot be undone.
delete.hasChildren_one: A term with sub-terms cannot be deleted. Move its {{count}} sub-term to another parent (Move to…) or delete it first.
delete.hasChildren_other: A term with sub-terms cannot be deleted. Move its {{count}} sub-terms to another parent (Move to…) or delete them first.
delete.refusedChildren: It has sub-terms now: move or delete them first.

menus.title: Menus
menus.description: Navigation for the site. The theme shows a menu in each of its locations; a menu named like a location is the one shown there.

locations.title: Theme locations
locations.hint: Places the active theme shows a menu.
locations.none: The active theme declares no menu locations, so it shows none of these menus.

others.title: Other menus
others.hint: Not in a location of the active theme; another theme may show them.

empty.title: No menus yet
empty.body: A menu is a list of links to pages, terms and other addresses, nested as deep as the theme shows.

create.title: New menu
create.description: A menu named like a theme location is shown there. The name cannot change later.
create.label: Label
create.labelHint: How the admin lists it, e.g. Social links
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lower-case, without spaces or / ? # % < > " ' \ `, at most {{max}} characters.

errors.chars: Use no spaces and none of / ? # % < > " ' \ `, and not . or ..
errors.form: Use lower case, without spaces around it.
errors.label: At most {{max}} characters.

editor.label: Label
editor.labelHint: For the admin; the site shows the items.
editor.name: Name
editor.nameFixed: The name decides the theme location and cannot change.
editor.treeHint: Drag an item by its handle, sideways to nest it, or use its menu to move, indent and outdent.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.body: Add pages, posts, terms or custom links from Add items. They appear here in the order the site shows them.

editor.targetMissing: Missing: deleted, trashed or not readable. Remove it to save.

problems.tooMany: A menu holds at most {{max}} items; this one has {{count}}.
problems.tooDeep: Nested deeper than the site shows ({{max}} levels): outdent it.
problems.badUrl: Not an address the site links to: use http://, https:// or a path starting with /.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to this menu are not saved and will be lost.

delete.confirmBody: The menu and its items go. Undo brings them back for a few seconds.
delete.confirmUnsaved: Your unsaved changes to it are discarded too.
delete.confirmLocation: The theme stops showing a menu in {{location}}.

add.title: Add items
add.description: New items go to the end; drag them into place.
add.failed: The content could not be loaded.
add.full: A menu holds at most {{max}} items; {{left}} more fit.
add.urlHint: http://, https:// or a path on this site starting with /
add.urlInvalid: Use http://, https:// or a path starting with / (no spaces).
add.linkLabelHint: Empty: the site shows the address.

item.title: Edit menu item
item.description: Changes stay in the draft until you save the menu.
item.label: Label
item.labelHintLink: Empty: the site shows the address.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.description: Send visitors and search engines from old addresses to new ones. When a published item's address changes, its redirect is added here by itself.

301.label: Moved permanently
301.hint: Permanent: browsers and search engines remember the new address.

302.label: Found (temporary)
302.hint: Temporary: visitors go there for now, and the old address stays the one search engines keep.

307.label: Temporary redirect
307.hint: Temporary, and the request method is kept (a form post stays a post).

308.label: Permanent redirect
308.hint: Permanent, and the request method is kept (a form post stays a post).

410.label: Gone
410.hint: Visitors get the “gone” page instead of being sent on. The target is still required but not used.

empty.title: No redirects yet
empty.body: Add one to send an old address somewhere new, or import a CSV file. Moved content adds its own.

redirects.deletedHint: Undo brings it back; its hit count starts again at 0.
redirects.restoreFailed: Could not restore the redirect from {{source}}
redirects.deleteFailed: Could not delete the redirect from {{source}}

form.description: Visitors who open the From address are sent to the To address.
form.sourceHint: A path on this site, starting with /. It also matches with the trailing slash added or removed.
form.targetHint: A path on this site, or a full address starting with https:// or http://.
form.existsHint: Replace redirect changes its target and code; its hit count stays.
form.gone: This redirect was deleted meanwhile. Close the dialog and create it again.

source.empty: Enter the path to redirect from.
source.path: Use a path starting with /, without spaces.

target.target: Use a path starting with / or an address starting with http:// or https://, without spaces.

import.title: Import redirects
import.description: A CSV file with one redirect per line: source,target,code. A first line source,target,code is skipped. Every line is checked first; if any is wrong, nothing is imported. An existing source gets the file's target and code.
import.hint: or drop it here (at most 1 MiB)
import.sampleCaption: The first rows of the file
import.tooMany: An import takes at most {{max}} rows. Split the file.
import.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than 1 MiB. Split it into smaller files.
import.errorsTitle: Nothing was imported. Fix these lines and import the file again.
